summary: Formalize Goal contracts and extraction ownership

delivery.outcome: A local draft Wellmanifest Goal standard formalizes observed delivery/adoption/recovery contracts with immutable provenance, machine-readable extraction mapping and deterministic conformance.
nonGoals: No runtime move or changed behavior in Goal
No second semantic owner for existing Wellmanifest packs
No claimed exhaustive coverage of every Goal module
No deployed CI or fleet adoption claim

architecture.decision: Version a composition/extraction catalog rather than copying execution code. Pin Goal source and existing pack routing. Verify its closed model, authority boundary and extraction evidence offline. Preserve existing runtime interfaces and IDs.
architecture.rollback: Keep the seed and remove or revert only this ticket's local draft; no adopter has been changed.

validation.evidence: 13 rules and 14 immutable source blobs verified locally; not runtime or semantic certification
Pending local managed gate; no external publication
